##### Project general facts

Lunara Tower by Tarrad Development emerges as an exceptional residential address, a beautifully proportioned building of seven residential floors rising above a ground level and two basement levels, offering a curated collection of one and two-bedroom homes. Comprising one hundred and nineteen residences, this thoughtfully designed development achieves remarkable efficiency, with sellable area representing a remarkable proportion of the allowable gross floor area. Every residence has been carefully planned to maximise space, light, and comfort, creating a refined sanctuary where contemporary design meets everyday practicality.

The amenities at Lunara Tower are thoughtfully gathered on a complete rooftop level, creating a vibrant social hub for residents to enjoy. The rooftop features a stunning swimming pool and a dedicated kids' pool, alongside a fully equipped gymnasium, a serene spa, and a beautifully appointed co-working space for those who work from home. Residents also enjoy a games room, a kids' play area, a multipurpose hall, a barbecue area, a padel court, and an amenities reception, ensuring that relaxation, wellness, productivity, and connection are all effortlessly catered for within the building.

The residences at Lunara Tower are beautifully furnished, with every detail carefully considered to create an atmosphere of warmth and refined living. The interiors showcase a harmonious palette of ivory stone tones, champagne metal accents, and colourless glass, while continuous balcony bands, slender dark glazing frames, and sculptural supports establish a recognisable residential identity. Each home is delivered fully furnished with premium finishes, ensuring that residents can immediately immerse themselves in the comfort and elegance of their new home, while the chamfered corners and clear glazing articulate the building's presence on its three street frontages with quiet distinction.

##### Location description and benefits

Wadi Al Safa 3 offers a well-connected and increasingly desirable setting, positioned along three road frontages that provide excellent accessibility to the wider city. This thriving neighbourhood is served by the Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Road as its principal regional connection, alongside Dubai-Al Ain Road and Umm Suqeim Street, ensuring that every journey is effortless and every destination within comfortable reach. The area's strategic position places it at the heart of a rapidly evolving district, where convenience and opportunity converge.

The neighbourhood enjoys outstanding connectivity to the city's most popular destinations, with IMG Worlds of Adventure and Global Village just moments away, alongside Dubai Hills Mall, Dubai International Academic City, and Mall of the Emirates all within an easy journey. Residents benefit from proximity to the iconic Dubai Mall and Downtown district, Dubai Marina Mall, and Dubai International Airport, making both business and leisure effortlessly accessible. For global travel, Al Maktoum International Airport is also within comfortable reach, ensuring that the world is always close at hand.

The surroundings offer a wealth of retail, dining, and entertainment experiences that enrich daily life, from world-class shopping destinations to vibrant cultural and leisure attractions. The area's continued growth and investment in infrastructure signal a bright future, making it an increasingly attractive choice for homeowners and investors seeking both comfort and long-term value. This distinguished location truly offers the best of both worlds, combining the tranquillity of a well-planned community with the dynamic energy of one of the world's most exciting cities.
